title: MCP server is hand-rolled JSON-RPC rather than the official MCP SDK
evidence: server.py:27 MCPServer implements initialize/notifications-initialized/tools-list/tools-call directly over stdio with no mcp package import
suggestion: Acceptable — protocol handshake, version negotiation, tool schemas with annotations, and error codes are all correct; noted only for cross-run comparison

title: Coverage is 0.93, not full
evidence: scores.json test_coverage=0.93, defect_rate=1.0; 9 test methods + 23 sample-question subTests all pass, zero skips
suggestion: Some branches (e.g. rarer error paths / neighbors kinds) are unexercised; not required by spec

title: top_scorers deliberately reports unavailable instead of fabricating
evidence: soccer.py:246 top_scorers returns {'available': False, ...} because CSVs hold team goals not individual scoring events
suggestion: Correct honesty; spec marks top scorers as 'if inferable' so this is not a gap

title: standings refuses knockout competitions rather than emitting a bogus table
evidence: soccer.py:213 raises ValueError for non-league competitions; competition_results() covers cup/knockout grouping instead
suggestion: Appropriate separation of league table vs knockout fixtures
